quote.text: It is not the man who has too little who is poor, but the one who hankers after more.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Remember that true wealth in raising children comes from the quality of love and guidance you provide, not from material abundance; contentment and gratitude lead to a more fulfilling family life.
    • Teach your children the value of simplicity by modeling an appreciation for what you have, helping them understand that the constant pursuit of more can detract from the joy of the present moment.
  • Leadership:
    • A wise leader recognizes that the pursuit of endless ambition can cloud judgment; focus on serving others and seek balanced decisions rather than accumulating power or status.
    • Embody a spirit of contentment and responsibility, inspiring your team to value sustainable progress over insatiable desire, which ultimately fosters a more harmonious and productive environment.
  • Product Management:
    • When designing or refining a product, prioritize solving genuine customer problems over chasing every latest trend, ensuring that your offerings fulfill a real need rather than creating unnecessary complexities.
    • Adopt a mindset of continuous improvement with clear, focused goals, understanding that constant dissatisfaction and an endless quest for more features can dilute the value of your product and exhaust resources.
